name: Zen'yasai
source:
A week before the school festival. Soichiro Kiriharais in the festival executive committee. There are five girls around the hero, each with their own troubles. Will his curiosity, kindness and persistence make them open up to him? 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
距离学园祭还有一周。桐原宗一郎 (Soichiro Kiriharais) 担任音乐节执行委员会成员。主人公身边有五个女孩，每个女孩都有自己的烦恼。他的好奇心、善良和坚持会让他们向他敞开心扉吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
